notes.title: Fixed bugs and reduced difficulty overall
notes.content:
Fixed the bug of the respawn point in the second level stuck on the wall.
Spider Caro's movement speed has been increased.
Spider silk speed has been increased.
Spider silk distance has been increased.
The difficulty of the first level has been reduced.
